tool_args.rationale: The measured y/u_now ratios cluster near 2.09 across the expanded batch despite substantial variation in x_now and mem_conv, supporting an uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep response. Fit its two parameters numerically using all training rows; the five additional rows remove the original small-sample ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Observed response scales nearly linearly with u_now over the sampled range; this law does not explain the explicit horizon dependence suggested by the temporal signatures.
Predictions would depend on x_now; large changes in x_now at similar u_now do not produce corresponding changes in y.

The fine trajectory batch increased the sample to eight rows; the inputs show a simple u_now-proportional response with little residual horizon variation, so further measurement is not needed to distinguish the supported mechanism.
